extendedData.name: OracleText
extendedData.value:
Put these cards in, coach! Each Blood Bowl Secret Lair Drop contains six fantasy football-flavored reskins of some of our favorite cards. You can consider each spell a new strategy for your collection playbook, or the key move to winning your next game. It’s football like you’ve never experienced—and your opponents will never see it coming!

Contents:
• 1x Foil Borderless Approach of the Second Sun as “Touchdown!”
• 1x Foil Borderless Rewind as “Re-Roll”
• 1x Foil Borderless Bone Splinters as “Both Down”
• 1x Foil Borderless Fling as “Throw Team-Mate”?
• 1x Foil Borderless Defense of the Heart as “Perfect Defense”
• 1x Foil Borderless Fellwar Stone as “The Ball”
